items.name: Scan
items.summary: A configured, executable scan over a table snapshot.

methods.name: logical_schema
methods.summary: Get a shared reference to the logical [`Schema`] of the scan (i.e. the output schema of the scan). Note that the logical schema can differ from the physical schema due to e.g. partition columns which are present in the logical schema but n…

methods.name: physical_predicate
methods.summary: Get the predicate [`PredicateRef`] of the scan. Returns the predicate pushed down to the physical scan, if any was derived.

methods.name: physical_schema
methods.summary: Get a shared reference to the physical [`Schema`] of the scan. This represents the schema of the underlying data files which must be read from storage.

methods.name: scan_metadata
methods.signature: fn scan_metadata(&self, engine: Arc<dyn Engine>) -> SendableScanMetadataStream
methods.summary: Stream the per-file [`ScanMetadata`] for this scan, driving log replay on `engine`.

methods.name: scan_metadata_from
methods.signature: fn scan_metadata_from<T: Iterator<Item = RecordBatch> + Send + 'static>(&self, engine: Arc<dyn Engine>, existing_version: Version, existing_data: Box<T>, existing_predicate: Option<PredicateRef>) -> SendableScanMetadataStream
methods.summary: Stream [`ScanMetadata`] incrementally starting from a previously observed state.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.summary: Get a shared reference to the [`Snapshot`] of this scan.

methods.name: table_root
methods.summary: The table's root URL. Any relative paths returned from `scan_data` (or in a callback from [`ScanMetadata::visit_scan_files`]) must be resolved against this root to get the actual path to the file.

items.name: ScanBuilder
items.summary: Builder to scan a snapshot of a table.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Finalize the builder into a [`Scan`], validating the configured schema and predicate.

methods.name: with_kernel_all_struct_stats
methods.summary: Experimental: Use kernel's all_struct statistics mode (AFFECTS ULP). This is a preview of the modernization - use for experimentation.

methods.name: with_predicate
methods.signature: fn with_predicate(self, predicate: impl Into<Option<PredicateRef>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Optionally provide an expression to filter rows. For example, using the predicate `x < 4` to return a subset of the rows in the scan which satisfy the filter. If `predicate_opt` is `None`, this is a no-op.

methods.name: with_schema
methods.summary: Provide [`Schema`] for columns to select from the [`Snapshot`].

methods.name: with_schema_opt
methods.summary: Optionally provide a [`SchemaRef`] for columns to select from the [`Snapshot`]. See [`ScanBuilder::with_schema`] for details. If `schema_opt` is `None` this is a no-op.

methods.name: with_skip_stats
methods.summary: Skip file statistics during kernel log replay.

items.name: SendableScanMetadataStream
items.summary: A boxed, `Send`able stream of [`ScanMetadata`] results produced while scanning a snapshot.
